existing_proofs_preserved: Complete stable row softmax has original and reciprocal Real formulas, access safety, successful execution and frame. Full relative FP reciprocal equivalence retains its explicit division rule. The public Real formula covers the active prefix of B lanes and masks negative infinity correctly.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: All loads, max/exp/sum/division and masked output writes are represented.
Block/warp selection, allocation and full row grid remain outside public row contracts.

dtype_review: Input and inherited output dtype are not materialized as a typed family: RegionName kernels and the default real/fp32 FP rule do not enumerate half/bfloat/fp64 load/promotion/output-store structure.
branch_review: The >=2048 and >=4096 warp choices are host branches; kernel masks and arbitrary positive block size already exist. Host next_power_of_2(n_cols) needs connection to complete row coverage; this review does not request execution on invalid zero-width reduction configurations.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper allocates y and launches all n_rows after block and warp selection.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Existing per-program IO does not compose those operations into the returned matrix.

structural_gaps.finding: The original dtype-dependent row load/store has no typed source/storage selector in the public model.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Complete admitted dtype routes are structural prerequisites before exact exp/division/cast assumptions can be deferred.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native exp, reduction scheduling, division/reciprocal relation and dtype-specific rounding may be explicitly deferred after exact route binding.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
